** Major** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Heavy lift** **Preserve bridged item schemas instead of converting them to strings.** For an external array of numeric arrays, this branch returns `""`. `ItemType()` then returns `string`, and all three schema generators advertise string elements. The valid argument `[[1.5]]` no longer matches the generated schema. Previously, the generated unconstrained array did not exclude it. JSON Schema applies `items` to each array element. ([json-schema.org](https://json-schema.org/understanding-json-schema/reference/array?utm_source=openai)) Absent or untyped external `items` also become string-only. Preserve the external item schema separately from the built-in string default. Keep explicit string arrays unchanged.
